public_boundaries: src/runtime-client.mjs: runCheck({cwd, words, options}, ports) with --files [--json]
src/runtime-client.mjs: runTry({cwd, words, options}, ports) and readTryOwner({cwd, story}, ports)
runtime_reason: The owning prompts have no Runtime interfaces. Git discovery, tar archive hashing, private saved-state files and stdio JSON-RPC MCP transport are native and unbound.

criteria.text: `pdd test --files` prints `Source SHA-256: <64-hex>` immediately after the file-count summary line without network access, and `pdd test --files --json` includes top-level `source_sha256` matching the uploaded archive digest.

Starting or reusing a Try with `pdd simulate` prints `Try source: sha256:<64-hex>; engine: <engine_sha>` immediately after the Try budget line (or `Try source: sha256:<64-hex>` when `engine_sha` is unknown or absent), to stdout in browser mode and to stderr in `--cli` or `--serve` mode.
Calling `try_open` or `try_state` in `pdd mcp` returns `source_sha256` and `engine_sha` for the active Try session alongside its entries, saved data and budget.

cases.given: Isolated Harbor Git repository with no network or sign-in
cases.when: runCheck with --files and --files --json, then runTry capture
runTry creates a Try and a second runTry reuses it

cases.given: CLI or serve door Try setup
readTryOwner returning model/record source_sha256 and engine_sha
